periodicity.text: The light curve is dominated by a smooth sinusoid with period 0.25361 d (Lomb-Scargle power 0.78); the adopted 1.52170 d is 6.00 x that. The true period is more likely 0.25361 d (pulsation or spots) or 0.50722 d (contact binary), and the 'eclipses' may not be eclipses.

checks: No eclipse at 15 of 162 covered epochs where the 1.52170 d period predicts one (each under half the typical depth, > 5 sigma below it). The period is probably wrong - the dips seen may be separate eclipses of a longer-period system.
